lead: Girish Karnad was an Indian writer, born on 19 May 1938 in Matheran.
He died on 10 June 2019 in Bengaluru at the age of 81.
He is associated with work such as Tale Danda and Hayavadana (Play) and has been recognised with Jnanpith Award and Padma Bhushan.
The sections that follow break down Girish Karnad's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
